bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_lep_nh u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_mem1r1w.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_slice_lep.sv && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.045 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepnh/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepnh/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-LEPV (owner 10-18 "remove ties where cheap"): HOST_EN 0 variant of the end-slice link-port leaf s81sl_lep for the three endpoints without the host plane (s_0S / s_0N via dsdv_slice_lepw, s_7S via dsdv_slice_lepe_nh). Same macros, placement, outline and E / W / S faces as s81sl_lep; NO N face: t_host / t_kd / f_host / f_lf / f_ks and l0_st / l1_st are not ports, the THOST / TKD pending registers, host pin flops and f_host / f_ks / f_lf registers are generated out; a HOST / KS frame arriving here is a protocol fault. Replaces 3 x 131 b of tied die pads. HOURLY-S81/LEP 10-19 (after --cts gate 20261018-175853 FAIL clock_rule pin-flop spread TT 128.8 / FF 115.9, GRT 0, timing met): 16 per-region clock roots by 2-D k-means (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, OT_CKKM_K 16, proven on s81sl_xr1 128/113 -> 48.6/46.4); io_hold_margin 0.025 (KITS rule 10-18); bench min_count_regex gains its capture group. Same RTL, ports, cycles, SDC. S81-FIX3 10-19 (route s81sl_lepnh-90fc20580 NEEDS_RTL TT -55.92 / FF -7.15, DRC 0): CLASSIFIED -- all 66 TT setup violators are lane-1 TX SRAM rd_out (macro clk->q 421 ps TT) -> WREG forward mux AO21 -> ~265 ps buffered wire across the lane-0 column -> lo1_d output pin flop (distance from macro to pin face; not fanout, not logic depth, not IO: input/output slack +356/+320); FF hold -7.15 = WREG wd_q -> SRAM wd_in (macro clock 5 CTS delay buffers later than the wd_q leaf). Fix: RTL TXRP 1 = one read pipeline register beside the SRAM column (odr; lo_v / lo_d +1 edge, credit round trip ~8 <= CRED 8, full rate); hold_margin 0.03 -> 0.045 for the macro write pins; io_hold_margin 0.025 -> 0.03 (KITS rule); reset_landing 2 stages (route probe rst_n capture 195 ps; ROOT-RST, reset release +2). Outline, macros, pins unchanged.
